title: WhatsApp Study
description: Live and historical view of the WhatsApp LLM study, fed from Firestore by dashboard/export_to_postgres.py.

list.name: abandon_hours
list.label: Abandon after (hours)
list.description: A conversation that is not ended and has been silent this long counts as abandoned.

panels.title: Active conversations
panels.description: Sampled every poll tick, zeros included, so the line stays flat at 0 when nothing is happening. Active = not ended and the participant's conversation was updated within the window. Awaiting rating = blocked on a trust-rating reply (initial or check-in).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  logged_at AS time,
  active_5m       AS "active (5 min)",
  active_30m      AS "active (30 min)",
  awaiting_rating AS "awaiting rating"
FROM rt_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(logged_at)
ORDER BY 1
SELECT logged_at AS time, active_5m AS value FROM rt_metrics ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT logged_at AS time, active_30m AS value FROM rt_metrics ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT logged_at AS time, awaiting_rating AS value FROM rt_metrics ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Poller last tick
panels.description: If this is more than a minute old the poller is not running.

targets.rawSql: SELECT logged_at AS value FROM rt_metrics ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Participants (conversations started in the selected time range)

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM wa_messages WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM wa_ratings WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Messages per 5 min
panels.description: User and assistant messages, gap-filled to zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket_gapfill('5 minutes', ts) AS time,
  role AS metric,
  coalesce(count(*), 0) AS value
FROM wa_messages
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Conversations started / completed per hour
panels.description: Started = first message received. Completed = debrief sent. Gap-filled to zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, coalesce(started, 0) AS "started", coalesce(completed, 0) AS "completed" FROM (
  SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 hour', started_at) AS time, count(*) AS started
  FROM wa_conversations WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1
) s
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 hour', debriefed_at) AS time, count(*) AS completed
  FROM wa_conversations WHERE $__timeFilter(debriefed_at) GROUP BY 1
) c USING (time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Breakdowns (conversations started in the selected time range)
Outcome
panels.description: Abandoned = not ended and silent for more than $abandon_hours hours. Never rated = dropped before the initial trust rating.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
      WHEN phase = 'ended' THEN 'completed (debriefed)'
      WHEN NOT intro_sent OR phase = 'awaiting_initial_rating' THEN 'never rated'
      WHEN last_activity_at < now() - make_interval(hours => $abandon_hours) THEN 'abandoned'
      ELSE 'in progress'
    END AS outcome, count(*) AS value
FROM wa_conversations
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Variant assignment
panels.description: Randomisation balance across the five prompt conditions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(variant, 'unassigned') AS variant, count(*) AS value
FROM wa_conversations
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ad source
panels.description: First referral's ad id from the Click-to-WhatsApp webhook. 'no referral' = arrived without an ad click.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(ad_source_id, 'no referral') AS ad, count(*) AS value
FROM wa_conversations
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Trust rating by variant: initial vs latest
panels.description: Mean initial (before the conversation) and most recent trust rating, 1-10, per prompt condition. n = participants with at least one rating.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  variant,
  round(avg(initial_rating)::numeric, 2) AS "initial",
  round(avg(latest_rating)::numeric, 2)  AS "latest",
  count(*) AS "n"
FROM wa_conversations
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND n_ratings > 0
GROUP BY variant ORDER BY variant

panels.title: Mean trust rating over time (all participants)
panels.description: Hourly mean of every rating submitted. Gaps are hours with no ratings.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket_gapfill('1 hour', ts) AS time,
  avg(score) AS "mean rating"
FROM wa_ratings
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Turns per conversation
panels.description: User messages per conversation, one bucket per turn.

targets.rawSql: SELECT user_turn_count AS value FROM wa_conversations WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND intro_sent

SELECT extract(epoch FROM (last_activity_at - started_at)) / 60.0 AS value
FROM wa_conversations
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND user_turn_count > 0
SELECT latest_rating AS value FROM wa_conversations WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND latest_rating IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Most recently active
panels.description: Participants are shown by salted hash only; the raw phone number is not in this database.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  phone_hash AS participant,
  variant,
  language,
  phase,
  CASE
      WHEN phase = 'ended' THEN 'completed (debriefed)'
      WHEN NOT intro_sent OR phase = 'awaiting_initial_rating' THEN 'never rated'
      WHEN last_activity_at < now() - make_interval(hours => $abandon_hours) THEN 'abandoned'
      ELSE 'in progress'
    END AS outcome,
  user_turn_count AS turns,
  initial_rating AS "initial rating",
  latest_rating AS "latest rating",
  ad_source_id AS "ad id",
  started_at,
  last_activity_at,
  debriefed_at
FROM wa_conversations
WHERE $__timeFilter(last_activity_at)
ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC
LIMIT 200
